authority_basis: Central Index Provenance: rule ID + mapping version required for rule-based base indices
parameter_map-JRA v0.2: UNKNOWN fields use neutral 50 + missing flag deterministically

JRA-CANONICAL-COMPONENT-REPLAY-v1.applies_when: caller supplies frozen canonical component value with rule_id + mapping_version + evidence refs

JRA-UNKNOWN-NEUTRAL-50-v1.applies_when: canonical numeric mapping/value is unavailable, inapplicable to a newcomer, or evidence is insufficient for reproducible numeric scoring
JRA-UNKNOWN-NEUTRAL-50-v1.semantics: 50 is transport-neutral only; it is not ability=50, probability=50%, weakness, or market belief

JRA-NOT-APPLICABLE-v1.applies_when: the active canon explicitly declares an index not applicable

newcomer_policy.winner_reaudit_trigger: two or more independent positive evidence groups may trigger Winner Re-Audit, never automatic W

prohibited: treating neutral 50 as a formal ability score
using odds/VMI as physical KRS ability input
claiming CALCULATED without canonical rule provenance
